title: Tech Note: Working with 4D Dialogs within a Plug-in

historical_commentary.text: The classic 4D plug-in API and 4D Dialog mechanism described here have been superseded by 4D's modern component architecture, meaning the specific plug-in integration approach is dated; the general concept of a password-gated security dialog remains a common, still-relevant application feature, though modern implementations would rely on 4D's more capable and secure current authentication options rather than a bespoke plug-in dialog.
related_updates: 4D's classic plug-in API has been superseded by its modern component architecture, changing how such native dialogs would be built today
Modern 4D applications would typically use current, more secure authentication mechanisms rather than a bespoke username/password dialog
